instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "See which referral codes are live, what a friend who types one gets, and what each sale earns under my referral reward rules", and give it rules (the person's referral reward rule rows); events (The referral events: { kind?, subject, material: { event_type?, referral_code?, target?, referrer_account_id?, occurred_at } }).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:work-out-referral-codes and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads the referral events a person saved (a code made, a code withdrawn, a signup that named a referrer) and works out the codes: who made each one, what it points at, and whether it is still live.
4. It reads and keeps nothing: it works from your request and answers its whole result; you keep any row it hands back.
